qualification.details: Candidates must have completed their Graduate Degree or Diploma in the relevant stream between 2022 and 2026. The eligible streams are: | Arts Commerce Science Computer Applications Business Administration Hotel Management BMS (Bachelor of Management Studies) BAF (Bachelor of Accounting and Finance) Social Work Bachelor of Design Electrical Engineering (Diploma) Electronics Engineering (Diploma) Mechanical Engineering (Diploma) Mechanical Engineering (Degree) | Specific minimum percentage/division requirements for each stream are not available in the official notification. | Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.

selection_process: Screening of Applications: A Screening Committee will screen all applications received. Candidates must submit the application form complete in all respects. Written Test or Interview and Practical: Selection will be based on any one or more of these methods
as decided by AVNL-MTPF. Merit List: Selection will be based on merit. If two or more candidates score equal marks

how_to_apply: AVNL MTPF Ambarnath is accepting applications only through the offline mode. Follow the steps below to apply:
Download or obtain the application form as per the format in Annexure-A of the official advertisement.
Fill in personal details, educational qualifications, and category information completely and accurately.
Paste a recent passport-size photograph on the form.
Attach self-attested copies of the required documents (date of birth proof, educational certificates, and caste certificate, if applicable).
Sign and date the declaration section of the application form.
Send the completed application by post to the address given below, ensuring it reaches MTPF on or before 04 September 2026.
Postal Address: The Chief General Manager, Machine Tool Prototype Factory, Ordnance Estate, Ambarnath, Dist-Thane, Maharashtra, Pin – 421502.

content_sections.heading: AVNL MTPF Ambarnath Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: AVNL MTPF Ambarnath has announced 48 vacancies for Graduate and Diploma Apprentices across the following streams: Out of the total vacancies, 1 post is reserved for the Orthopedically Handicapped (OH) category under the 3% PH horizontal reservation, within the Commerce stream. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease based on the actual requirement at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: AVNL MTPF Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have completed their Graduate Degree or Diploma in the relevant stream between 2022 and 2026. The eligible streams are: Arts Commerce Science Computer Applications Business Administration Hotel Management BMS (Bachelor of Management Studies) BAF (Bachelor of Accounting and Finance) Social Work Bachelor of Design Electrical Engineering (Diploma) Electronics Engineering (Diploma) Mechanical Engineering (Diploma) Mechanical Engineering (Degree) Specific minimum percentage/division requirements for each stream are not available in the official notification. Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: AVNL MTPF Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum age at the time of engagement shall not be less than 18 years. The maximum age limit for Unreserved (UR) category candidates is as specified for each post; the exact maximum age figure is not available in the official notification. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PWBD/EWS candidates will be as per Government of India directives. Reserved category candidates applying against an unreserved post will be treated as General category, and no age relaxation will be given in such cases. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: AVNL MTPF Apprentice 2026 Salary/ Stipend Structure
AVNL MTPF Ambarnath Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening of Applications: A Screening Committee will screen all applications received. Candidates must submit the application form complete in all respects. Written Test or Interview and Practical: Selection will be based on any one or more of these methods, as decided by AVNL-MTPF. Merit List: Selection will be based on merit. If two or more candidates score equal marks, the candidate older in age (by date of birth) will be given preference in the merit list. Result Declaration: Final selection results will be published only on the official AVNL website. No TA/DA: No travelling allowance or dearness allowance will be paid for attending the test or interview. AVNL-MTPF reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards if a higher number of eligible applications is received. The selection process outlined above is tentative and may vary based on administrative or business requirements.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for AVNL MTPF Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Valid document evidencing date of birth (Matriculation School Certificate / Birth Certificate) Educational certificates - mark sheets and degree/diploma certificates Caste certificate (for candidates belonging to a reserved category) Recent passport-size photograph (to be pasted on the application form) Valid original photo ID (such as Aadhaar Card) at the time of interview, medical examination, or joining, if called

content_sections.text: AVNL MTPF Ambarnath is accepting applications only through the offline mode. Follow the steps below to apply: Postal Address: The Chief General Manager, Machine Tool Prototype Factory, Ordnance Estate, Ambarnath, Dist-Thane, Maharashtra, Pin – 421502.
